description: What happens to a pending Edit when its level commits, and can Update still complete it afterwards? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0).
